targets.summary: EFC kernels should probably be filtered out when no epilogue is being fused, so plain GEMM autotuning doesn't include the extra EFC candidates.
targets.evidence: The maintainer asked whether EFC kernels should be filtered out when no epilogue is used. The commented call `non_efc_kernels = get_compatible_kernels(args, cc_int, metadata_filter=_exclude_efc_kernels)` stays the same. The EFC lookup right after it, `efc_kernels = get_compatible_kernels(args, cc_int, metadata_filter=_include_efc_kernels_only)`, is now wrapped in `if config.epilogue_fusion: efc_kernels = get_compatible_kernels(...)` with `else: efc_kernels = []`. So EFC candidates are dropped from autotuning when epilogue fusion is off, which is the filtering the maintainer suggested. One caveat: the check uses the global `config.epilogue_fusion` flag rather than whether this particular GEMM gets an epilogue. That is still a reasonable equivalent, because fusion is decided later in the scheduler, after the candidate kernels are chosen.
